attack_effect.to_hit_rule: Successful strike against an unarmored being deals damage from acidic slime.

ability.name: vibration_sense

ability.name: fire_on_covered_victim
ability.trigger: When green slime covering a character is burned.

ability.name: cure_disease_vulnerability

ability.name: scraping_resistance
ability.effect: Clings in such a way that scraping it off is ineffective.

ability.name: finality_of_digestion
ability.effect: No magical revival is possible once the victim is completely digested, because nothing material remains.

steps.step: Green slime reaches a victim by dropping from above or by being stepped on.
It digests clothing and armor in 6 rounds.
After bare skin contact, it digests the victim in 1d4 rounds.
The victim is replaced by more green slime.

stat_block.hit_points_rule: Has Hit Dice equal to head count and maximum hit points on each Hit Die.

population_rules.rule: Hydras have 5-12 (1d8+4) heads.

attack_effect.effect: Each head attempts to bite an opponent each round; total attacks per round equal current head count.

attack_effect.trigger: For each 8 points of damage suffered.
attack_effect.effect: One head becomes useless.
attack_effect.termination: When all heads are destroyed, the hydra dies.

special_defense.name: save_progression

ability.name: regenerating_hydra
ability.trigger: 1d4 rounds after the hydra loses a head.
ability.effect: Grows 2 new heads, to a maximum of 12 heads.
ability.exception: Heads do not regrow if cauterized with fire before regrowth.

ability.name: aquatic_hydra
ability.effect: Has all standard hydra characteristics and abilities, but has fins rather than legs and lives underwater.

ability.name: judge_created_variants
ability.effect: The Judge may create other hydra variations, including hydras with fire breath for 8 points of damage per head or poisonous venom bites.

steps.step: Track total damage dealt to the hydra.
Each time accumulated damage reaches another 8 points, one head becomes useless.
When all heads are useless, the hydra dies.

ability.name: summoned_service
ability.effect: Undertakes whatever task the summoner commands, even if the task sends it hundreds or thousands of miles away.
ability.limitation: Obeys only the summoner and follows the command until the task is completed.

ability.name: hostility_to_protracted_tasks

ability.name: dispelled_return

ability.name: surprise_penalty

ability.name: cleric_spellcasting

ability.name: enhanced_cure_spells

ability.name: sustained_protection_from_evil

behavior_rules.rule: Not aggressive or violent by nature.

confidence_notes.note: Green Slime stat block is incomplete in the uploaded markdown. Only percent_in_lair, encounter pattern, alignment, movement, and armor_class were preserved directly; hit dice, save, morale, treasure_type, and xp were omitted rather than inferred.
Herd Animals and Giant Leech entries have visibly truncated stat blocks in the uploaded markdown. Only preserved fields were encoded.
Invisible Stalker, Kobold, and Lammasu stat blocks were reconstructed from flattened/corrupted table rows with high but not absolute confidence.
The Hydra treasure type line was normalized as "I (5-7 HD), K (8-9 HD), or M (10-12 HD)" because the source line is missing punctuation in the markdown.

The Ordinary Hawk grab text appears to contain a source/markup error because it says "If a griffon hits..." in the ordinary hawk paragraph. The grab mechanic was retained for Ordinary Hawk, but this may be a transcription issue in the source.

Horse morale values were preserved exactly as printed ("-2 or 0", "-1 or +1"), but the source does not explicitly label which value is untrained versus war-trained in the stat line; the war-training rule in prose was preserved separately.

Classification values such as fantastic_creature, beastman, construct, ooze, animal, and summoned_creature were normalized to fit the Monster Catalog schema when the source did not explicitly print a type line.
